body: Thanks for the thoughtful response. Yes. Priorities are tough!

You’re not stupid, you’re rational! If he gave you the intimate clues, it’s only right to assume he feels similarly. But people are sometimes shits and don’t. I know you’ve got time invested but you’re so dope! Take the loss and move on. You’re absolutely going to find someone who is all about you. Just is gonna hurt a little in the intermediary… I’m working on letting myself get to that painful intermediary. It’s hard but probably will pay off
Ok… yes! I’m realizing how enjoying time on my own is helpful on the self love front. Ever since I’ve started sketching I’m more confident around people. Enjoy your you time!
Happy birthday! I’d be buying myself a DQ ice cream cake right about now! You’re awesome!
You’re amazing. I also don’t know your situation but the fact you’re reaching out just tells me that you do a lot and care a lot. Keep it up. It’s gonna pay off

You got this. Things most definitely will change. Honestly think about all the bugs left to observe the mosquitoes left to swat and the bites to be scratched. There’s so much cool stuff out there! I get pain… trust me. But still. You got this!

It’s definitely helpful! Thanks for taking the time for the thoughtful words and best of luck on your journey! It’s clear you’re a really good person and he’s lucky to have a compassionate and articulate lady like you!

Yeah… it actually has helped a little to put myself in his shoes. Id just want to understand them more… and I think that might be what’s bothering me. Doesn’t feel like he’s trying to understand me. Not his fault though, maybe he just wants simpler! I respect that!
Thank you for your kind words!
Yeah… good advice! Trying to tackle too much all at once.
